title: Glessner's stable dovecote set higher, with proper pigeon holes
items: The nine pigeon holes in the stable's north gable on 18th Street are now round-headed and a stone course tall, as two photographs and an 1887 print show them. They had been narrow slits.
The holes and the ledge under them are about 10 inches higher, where the 1965 survey photograph, taken square to the gable, places them.
